name: folio
comment: PDFium is NOT acquired here. It is a GN/Chromium build with its own
toolchain and a multi-GB checkout; attempting it inside CMake is a trap.
It arrives as pinned prebuilt artefacts in third_party/pdfium (WP A2),
replaced by an owned GN pipeline at Phase 3 (plan §15.2).
PoDoFo 1.0+ is required, not 0.10.x: the MPL-2.0 option that makes static
linking into a proprietary iOS app clean only exists from 1.0 (plan §2.1).
